_comment: Hand-maintained rename table for stop identity. Pipeline input only — this
file is never shipped to the client. See scripts/README.md for provenance and
for how to add an entry.
Keys and values are UNPREFIXED slugs, as produced by stop_identity.stop_key
before the 'bus:'/'rail:' prefix is attached. An entry maps a name Metro has
stopped using onto the one it uses now, so a renamed stop keeps one continuous
series instead of splitting into two. Chains are followed; cycles raise.
Both tables are empty because no month in the 2025-07..2026-05 window has both
an added and a dropped key, which is the signature a rename leaves. The one
ambiguous case — line 28's san-vicente-fairfax -> san-vicente-orange-grove — is
left alone on purpose; see scripts/README.md. The known rail renames (e.g. 'APU
Station' -> 'APU / Citrus College Station') are GTFS-side mismatches, not
ridership-side ones, and belong to the geometry join.
